rules.title: Item-position fn-macro invocation requires a #[fn_macro] callee
rules.statement: An item-position invocation `name!{...}` resolves `name` against the function overload set; it is an error unless some overload is a function attributed `#[fn_macro]`. Unknown `name` is an error.

rules.title: fn-macro callee must return ItemList or QuoteItemBlob
rules.statement: A `#[fn_macro]` callee invoked at item position must have return type `ItemList` or `QuoteItemBlob`; any other return type is an error.

rules.title: fn-macro item callee takes Vec<ExprBlob> or no args
rules.statement: A `#[fn_macro]` callee at item position must have either zero parameters, or a single parameter of type `Vec<ExprBlob>`; any other parameter signature is an error.

rules.title: fn-macro item body parses as a comma-separated expression list
rules.statement: The raw token text of `name!{...}` is parsed as the argument list of a call `__c(<raw>)`; it must parse to EOF as a valid expression list, else an error. Empty body yields zero arguments.

rules.title: Zero-parameter fn-macro rejects supplied arguments
rules.statement: If the callee takes no parameters, the invocation must supply no arguments; supplying any argument is an error.

rules.title: Each fn-macro argument must be a parsed AST node
rules.statement: Each parsed argument of a `Vec<ExprBlob>` fn-macro must be a non-null AST object carrying a CODE tag; a malformed (non-pointer/null or CODE-less) argument is an error. Each argument is serialised into a per-call-site argument blob reconstituted at runtime as `ExprBlob`.

rules.title: ItemList-returning macro emits each contained item blob
rules.statement: When an item-position macro/metacall returns `ItemList`, every `QuoteItemBlob` in its `blobs` vector is emitted as a top-level item (via the host item-emit shim) in order.

rules.title: QuoteItemBlob-returning macro emits one item
rules.statement: When an item-position macro/metacall returns a single `QuoteItemBlob`, that value is emitted as one top-level item (via the host item-emit shim).

rules.title: Item-position metacall requires a free-function or static-method call
rules.statement: `metacall <expr>;` at item position requires `<expr>` to be a free-function call, generic (turbofish) call, or static-method call; any other expression form is an error.

rules.title: Item-position metacall arguments must be compile-time constants
rules.statement: Each argument of an item-position `metacall` is evaluated by CTFE (with module-const path folding) to a printable literal; an argument that is not a compile-time constant is an error.

rules.title: Item-position metacall callee must return QuoteItemBlob or ItemList
rules.statement: The callee of an item-position `metacall` must have return type `QuoteItemBlob` or `ItemList`; any other return type is an error.

rules.title: WritStatic turbofish type-args re-render to @-literal source
rules.statement: A turbofish type-argument that is a WritStatic literal (`Foo::<@{...}>`) is reconstructed to its original `@{...}` source form (objects `{k: v}`, arrays `[..]`, ints, neg-ints, floats, strings, bools, null, and `<type:..>` literals) rather than the non-reparsable `@hs_<hex>` rendering, so the synthesised thunk can re-parse it.
